subject: The secret I wasn't going to share expires tomorrow
preview_text: I set aside one last thing for 30-day users only. This is your final warning before it's gone.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. When we built the 30-day user list, I flagged a handful of you. The ones who stuck around but never pulled the trigger on the full toolkit. And I set something aside. A final, one-time offer that I wasn't even sure I'd send. But here it is.

This isn't a generic discount. It's the VIP upgrade path. Unlimited predictions across every league, every stat, every confidence score. The full AI engine that crushes gut feelings. It's the difference between guessing about Haaland's xG and knowing it. It expires in 24 hours. After that, the door closes and this list gets archived.

The feature? It's all of them. The deep player stats, the tactical breakdowns, the value bet alerts. It's the 'Premium' toggle in your app going from grayed out to fully unlocked. But only if you act before the deadline. This is the stack—everything we built to make you the smartest fan in the room.

Tap the button. Start your 3-day trial. See what it feels like to have every data point before you commit a dime. But you have to do it now. P.S. The real mistake isn't trying Premium. It's letting this final shot hit the crossbar and walk away. This is your last touch.
